name: anim_fin_vomit
subject: a big chubby shark made of glossy pink paint with yellow marble streaks, sticking up out of a paint puddle, stuffed full
desc: The shark's throat and cheeks swell up enormously, its eyes bulge, then it throws its head forward and vomits a huge gushing torrent of thick pink and yellow paint out of its mouth onto the floor, the paint splashing and piling up in a big gooey heap. Over-the-top and gross.
